fact: After a March 2026 mission, MINSA, WHO, HISP UiO and Saudigitus agreed next steps that include improving DHIS2 integration with the electronic logistics management system (eLMIS) and prioritising interoperability between platforms.
The Secretary of State for Health said Angola is developing the interoperability of ReDIV and IOTA with the national health information system based on DHIS2.
system: ReDIV and IOTA interoperability with DHIS2
